name: Branch circulation analyst
scenario: A library analyst prepares monthly reports from branch exports. Rebuilding the same dashboard is routine. Joining a legacy export can take several sessions even when it contains few rows.

tasks.title: Refresh the monthly renewals plot
tasks.description: Run the established notebook on the branch rollup and replace the chart in the circulation memo.
tasks.details: The rollup already uses the warehouse keys. Keep the same axes and caption.

tasks.title: Reconcile locker pickups with the branch register
tasks.description: Produce a reusable map between the new locker export and the older location register, with unresolved records in a separate sheet.
tasks.details: Use the two attached source notes. The output feeds the quarterly physical circulation count.

sections.heading: Export A | locker scans
sections.body: Each CSV row is a cabinet event. The support team occasionally re-sends a full day, so a scan may appear in two files. Local timestamps have no offset. Cabinet codes moved when the East Avenue unit was replaced in October.

sections.heading: Export B | location register
sections.body: Rows describe service locations, including rooms that have closed. An empty cabinet field means that the site has no locker. A match by street alone can assign both entrances to the same counter.

sections.heading: Acceptance checks
sections.body: Deliver one row per distinct pickup and retain the raw cabinet code alongside the normalized site key. Put unknown codes in a review sheet and report their counts. Verify that East Avenue has no pickups at its retired cabinet after the move.

tasks.title: Load the January acquisitions CSV
tasks.description: Import the vendor file, standardize date formatting, then confirm the row and spend totals against their header.
tasks.details: The purchasing system sent the current template; every row has an order-line key.

tasks.title: Combine entrance counter files
tasks.description: Build an hourly gate-count series across the two branches and flag coverage gaps.
tasks.details: One unit records local clock time. The replaced unit writes a cumulative total, and its counter wraps after a reboot.

tasks.title: Write the four-number board update
tasks.description: Copy approved totals from the February dashboard, add the percentage changes, and write a three-sentence note.
tasks.details: Charts are already approved. Spell out why the holiday week is excluded.

tasks.title: Audit the membership type crosswalk
tasks.description: Reconcile membership codes after the policy update and document which exceptions need a manual coding decision.
tasks.details: About 30 codes. Two old labels were reused for different patron types in different years; work from the change log.

tasks.title: Tabulate computer booking turnaways
tasks.description: Group the booking service export by branch and hour, run the known duplicate check, and email a table to the operations lead.
tasks.details: Use the weekly query and the existing dictionary. The export version is unchanged.

tasks.title: Check the digital renewal denominator
tasks.description: Trace an unexpected dashboard percentage back to the vendor feed, then write a reproducible test for the denominator.
tasks.details: The archive mixes attempts and completed renewals. One vendor changed the meaning of a blank success field.

holdouts.title: Join the returns feed for the quarterly memo
holdouts.description: Deliver a reproducible join and a short QA table before publishing the new returns totals.
holdouts.details: Two small source files are attached as a specification. Limit work to the returns table.

pdf.title: Returns reconciliation: handoff from branch operations

sections.heading: Files and grain
sections.body: The sorter export has one row per scan attempt. The circulation export has one row per posted return. A repeated scan can occur without a second return. Several self-check stations resend their last batch after reconnecting.

sections.heading: Keys and cutover
sections.body: Before February 8 the sorter used the last six characters of the item label. After the cutover it used the full label. A morning return can post after closing; treat posting time and scan time as different fields.

sections.heading: Sign-off
sections.body: Produce a reusable join plus a table showing linked, ambiguous, and missing records by branch. Preserve both raw keys for review. Check the night-return bin separately because it carries the next business date.

holdouts.check: Tests whether the supplied grain, key change and ambiguous joins prompt comparison with earlier reconciliation work.

holdouts.title: Refresh circulation charts for the April packet
holdouts.description: Rebuild the two existing chart panels from the warehouse view and replace their captions in the standard packet.
holdouts.details: The view already contains cleaned renewals and returns. Use the existing notebook; the requested change is a month filter.
holdouts.check: Tests whether an ordinary refresh receives a lighter correction than the nearby complex returns task.
